create_optimizer_for_model: create an optimizer for a PyTorch model using args with opt, lr, weight_decay, and momentum settings
get_parameter_groups_with_layer_decay: get parameter groups for a model with weight decay and layer-wise learning rate scaling
get_num_layer_for_convnext: get the layer ID for a ConvNeXt model parameter name to apply layer decay scheduling
create_layer_decay_value_assigner: create a LayerDecayValueAssigner with decay values to scale learning rates per layer group
create_lookahead_optimizer: create a Lookahead-wrapped optimizer by prefixing the opt argument with lookahead_ for improved convergence
